book.name: Luka
book.title: Orooka o lebo ka Luka wele

content: Adaano maYahuda neta ne kabareka legoone le Yeso ne
Ngmende a Yeso ka lyǝ atatara akwilǝ Ashili ka ka baale kanza aka zoole aromo aza orooka o lebo, na ana magame ma Ashili ma moole, ana o baala angmǝ aka Ashili nya Mosa ka anateandaasau ne de.
Nane bekaa kai na, “Bele ro orona legoone leeka o ezeze epa ena ne. Mana wa nyau legoone leena?”
Na Yeso kabare na, “Eyang eza ying be pirǝ, beleng na,
Legoone le ngmǝ a Yohana ondo batisma a suri a Ashili na, aromo ai?”
Nane beya tokpwe tone, nane laka o bekaana, “Te bekaana, ‘Wa suri a Ashili,’ a kayo bekaana, ‘Eyaka eta e kabare ka wai ne?’
Kanza te bekaana, ‘Wa suri aromo,’ aromo a cake neyo teza ro ka cale, o bekaana komana rose Yohana ondo o beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili wai.”
Nane maare ko bekaa kai na, “Teta rosa araaka le suri ne ne.”
Na Yeso bekaa ne na, “Mima anta bele o ying ka legoone le mana eyang eza epa eka eya gonta me ne.”
Angmǝ a gerpo aza ana ogoleamea ne nyane a Ashili
Na Yeso ka lyǝ izi ka o baala aromo angmǝ a gerpo na, “Ondo wa rene amea waye ka ara o inabi,
na wa nya ana ondo ogole arame a wa ale a begere a makeke ma yende, na wa rabo a saname.
Nangka a were o shende e inabi waye, na wa tong ozara wai oyende ana ogole me kawa mangka ayana o inabi me ba ne. Na ana ogole me ne ole wai, aane tarangga wai na wa kuri zora eyapa.
Na oromo me wa tong ozara o leere, na ana ogole me kang ola wai na o bora, aane eze wai epa ezǝng aane kang tarangga wai na wa kuri zora eyapa.
Na oromo me wa tong ozara o taaro, na ana ogole me ne ole wai aane juki wai aane were wai o yangga.
“Na ondo ara o inabi me wa bekaana, ‘Eya eyang ya naname? Eyang tonga kena kang ka lome kamea ang yeme, ang rose obena neyo tare kai.’
“Pate ka nyimi nangka ana ogole me ne laka kai nane bekaa tokpwe to ne na, ‘Kando kamea kayo jeka ocǝ me kaana, baya ate wong kai, a ocǝ ondo arame wa itǝ aoro.’
Nane wong kai ane tare e keze kai a malo ara inabi. “Eya ondo arame wayo ya ne?
Wayo deya ka wa wong ana ogole me, a wa nya ana ondo ara ame.” Nangka aromo ka neya akwilǝ a Ashili ne kone nyimi nane bekaana, “Kana Ashili baya nyimi aye ne.”
Na Yeso karene a yizi a dongdong aka pirkǝ na, “Eya bekazo ba ngmǝ epa ena a ana o beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili ne wela?

content.text: “ ‘Lecale leemea ana o sowa ne nyana,
leya le itǝ leeme a waale a yeme me

content: Bekazo be angmǝ ana a beya, pate ondooka wa rizi baaza lecale leme a wayo jukǝ okpwe wai a wa poso a nyokonyoko. A lecale leme le taru a wai a were amea a yo core angmǝ azaa wai, a yo nyanta wai kawa itǝ na ma'ena.”

Aza o bekaana ne rose na angmǝ a gerpo na aza o bena neta ne kabare ka o baala o kai ne. Na ana o baala angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa ka ana magame ma Ashili ma moole ne gere orona o meke o Yeso a saseya, nane kone boome ba aromo.
Be pirǝ aza o arsaza emate makekeba Ogomo Roma

Na ne gere orona o meke o kai kane ote kai ka ka rizi aza epa eka ka yo beka. Adorana ka lyǝ a taara te ogomo makeke mame. Nane nya aromo anyong a buru yende emate kane itǝ ana o kare o kai a yizi, na aromo me wore o bena ne aromo a rere ne. Na tong ne ba Yeso kane eze kai be pirǝ.
Andaaka atong, ne pirkǝ Yeso na, “Ondobaala, te rose o bena o beeze o kang baala e peng, o takang wore o bena o kala yeme a ondo ne, kanza o baale orona Ashili ba kap.
Wa rere o bena te are emate makeke a Ogomo ogong o Roma Kaisar na te bayai?”
Na Yeso ka ka rose anyong ane a buru naka bekaa ne na,
“Woreng na beyo bemate. O ululu ka leze le mana a aza beyo bemate me?”
Nane bekaana, “O Ogomo ogong o Roma Kaisar wai.” Naka bekaa ne na, “Nyimi waaza nyana Ogomo ogong o Roma Kaisar epa eka e Ogomo ogong o Roma Kaisar e, e nya Ashili epa e Ashili e.”
Nane ta cǝ orona o meke o kai ne aza epa eka ka beka arakaname a nyimi aromo. Na epa eme tere ne okpwe aza o kabare o kap o be pirǝ be ne, nane kome a set.
O baala ka Yeso ka eze aza o era kaimalo o gbwǝ
MaSadukiya ma yende,
kane beeze na malo o gbwǝ a era ta era ne, ne deye a Yeso ka be pirǝ. Nane bekaana,
“Ondo baala, Mosa ondo o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili wa wele ro oroka o bena, ondo wa gbwǝ a wa baya ondaye zora ayana, wa gwara o bena orone o wai ana ondaye me kawa ngmeng wai ayana.
A bena, arone yende ne zene neya a sondaare. Ondo o bora a nyimi one wa ana ondaye na wa gbwi zora kena.
Na o leere wa ana ondaye me na wa gbwi zora kena.
Na o taaro one wa ana ondaye me, nyimia ne anza ondaye me a ale orone o sondaare nane gbwizi zora ayana.
O maare na ondaye me wa gbwi.
A lengme lo era andaaka ne gbwizǝ, wayo itǝ ondaye mana a nyimi one, nangka pate one a sondaare ne tukǝ o ana o wai?”
Na Yeso bekaa ne na, “Aromo a were ana andaleme anza andaye, andaye kanza ne aleze a todo.
Pate ka nyimi andaaka neya kap ka were name ane kang bare o era a malo gbwǝ, ne era neta ana andaye ne a andaye kanza ne era ane ta ale a todo ne,
ne era neta gbwǝ kanza ne, aza o bena ne itǝ na atoma a surǝ a zaa shili. Ne itǝ ayana Ashili, o bena ne era a malo o gbwǝ.
Eta e kabare a kap ne, Mosa wa wore o bena andaaka ne gbwǝ neyo era, wa wele epa eka Ashili a beke, a epa eka Ashili a beke naana, ‘Mea Ashili Ibraheng, ka Ashili Ishaku, a Ashili a Yakub.’
Ai Ashili ana o gbwǝ taza ne, ai Ashili a pate andaaka ne gbwǝ a neya tare o kai ka e edang, neye ka ebeene.”
Na ana ondo ba nyimi ana o baala angmǝ aka Ashili a Mosa ne bekaana, “Ondo baala ba bekaa kap.”
Ondo ta zene kanza kawa ama pirǝ o kai ne.
Ondo oka Ashili a zakeka kala abuudu a Daoda belle
Na Yeso ka pirkǝ aromo a cak na, “Eyaka ana o baala angmǝ aka a Ashili a nya Mosa ne beeze na Ondooka Ashili a zake kena ka abuudu Daoda kai?
Daoda ka okpwe kai a nyimi o Seleera ka bekaana:

content.text: zongka ang ote ana o nyana o atau legoone lo
na o taara atau tobona to.” ’

content: Daoda wa rare kai na, ‘Ateokora.’ Nyimia waaza a wiinia aka ta kala o bena kena ka abuudu a wai ne?”
A aromo a pate ya konaza, na Yeso ka bekaa ana o tare o kai na,
“Ezana a sauwo ka ana o baala angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa, aza o ara okpwe one. Ne ambaza ma dibi ma moole ane yenga nyimi aromo, ane kang yeme a beye ne oko a nyimi ara ejamane
. Kanza ane yeme a nya ne ara o cikǝ a rere ba nyimi madandaro ma o gwarzanang maYahuda, ka ara o cikǝ a rere ara o gwara.
Neya ana o lyeeza magogoro ma agbwǝri andaye,
ane kang rabo a beya angmǝ ka Ashili adorana a laka ne. Abela aromo name Ashili a yo gǝǝzǝ ne ba cak.”

footnotes.text: Inabi wa nyaza ayana a lengleng kawa song a deze kanza wa zale uti na ecǝng, a agoleze e a makeke maYahuda.
Yeso ka kedeya okpwe o kai na lecale leeka ana o sowa ne nyana.
MaSadukiya neya o gwarnang ana magame ma Ashili ne kabare ka angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa. Ne ama ngmǝ na ne gwara okpwe ka aworme.
Ateokora wa bekaa Ateokora ong na: Ondooka Ashili a zake ka kala Daoda o gongnga o bekaana Daoda wa rare kai na Ateokora ong.
Aya a sanga beeze ka e canti na ara ejamane.
O lya magogoro ma agbwǝri Ashili a nare a nyimia angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa Pitowa 22.22.
